scope: Educational generic industrial robotic arm; no live control

symptoms.payload_mismatch: Configured payload / centre of gravity differs from tool
symptoms.joint_friction: Abnormal joint friction reported by qualified inspection
symptoms.supply_unstable: Supply instability verified by qualified personnel

faults.name: Payload configuration mismatch
faults.cause: Incorrect tool mass or centre-of-gravity configuration.
faults.action: Compare tool and workpiece data with approved payload settings; have an authorized technician correct configuration.
faults.provenance: UR protective-stop guidance; illustrative diagnostic conjunction.

faults.name: Joint mechanical degradation
faults.cause: Possible wear, looseness or abnormal friction.
faults.action: Keep equipment out of service pending qualified joint inspection; follow the model-specific service manual.
faults.provenance: UR guidance associates abnormal friction with possible mechanical failure; three-symptom rule is illustrative.

faults.name: Cooling-related overheating
faults.action: Qualified maintenance should inspect cooling paths and the reported temperature alarm using the equipment manual.

faults.name: Position feedback fault
faults.cause: Possible encoder or feedback wiring issue.
faults.action: Have qualified personnel inspect feedback diagnostics and wiring with the robot safely isolated.

faults.name: Pneumatic grip fault
faults.action: Secure the workpiece and isolate stored energy; qualified personnel should inspect air supply and leaks.

faults.name: Communication connection fault
faults.action: Qualified personnel should inspect the affected cable and connection after safe isolation.

faults.name: Power supply fault
faults.action: Refer supply diagnostics to qualified electrical maintenance; follow approved isolation procedures.

faults.name: Joint holding / brake fault
faults.action: Restrict access, secure supported loads using approved procedures, and request qualified service.

sources.title: Universal Robots - Understanding Protective Stops
sources.use: Payload and abnormal friction concepts; exact conditions are project assumptions.

sources.title: Universal Robots - C162 Error Code
sources.use: Manufacturer example linking incorrect payload mass/centre of gravity to protective stops.

sources.title: Universal Robots - e-Series Service Handbook, Protective Stop
sources.use: Troubleshooting flow for payload settings and abnormal joint friction; model-specific reference only.
